prompts.text: Добавь сводку по счёту: функция invoiceLine(invoice) в src/invoices/summary.js. Счёт: { id, issuedAt, items: [{ priceCents, qty }] }. Строка вида «Invoice 12 — issued Mar 5, 2026 — due Apr 4, 2026 — total $25.00», срок оплаты через 30 дней после выставления. Добавь тест.

rubric: The owner's structure complaints are duplicates of what the code already has («дублирование селекта ... он есть и у пульса», «кнопка ... сразу видно, что она не наша»). The better reply finds and reuses the project's own money and date helpers (src/shared/fmt.js cents2str and totalOf, src/shared/when.js shortDay and plusDays, src/shared/check.js need) instead of writing its own formatting, date arithmetic or validation, and says which it reused. Correct output and a passing test matter equally.

predict.note: on = the pace.ts reuse note on the first new source file of a prompt; off = MAKARASTY_PACE=off. The helpers have non-obvious names among ten modules; the one existing caller (src/orders/order.js) shows them. Ran 2026-11-25: 4/4 vs 4/4, judge 2:2 [M92].
